drhp.business: Ebix Limited operates a diversified portfolio spanning technology-enabled services (insurance, financial services, digital payments, healthcare, travel and e-learning) through its acquired Ebix Inc. businesses, alongside domestic hospitality (hotels, resorts, restaurants, cruise-related services and event spaces), QSR, and digital marketing services. sk.overview: The overnight ocean and coastal cruise industry in India is a nascent, high-growth segment of cruise tourism. Per the issuer-commissioned CRISIL Report (May 2026), the domestic market was valued at approximately Rs 8,301 million in Fiscal 2025 (up from Rs 5,764 million in Fiscal 2020, ~8% CAGR) but is estimated to have declined ~12% to Rs 7,325 million in Fiscal 2026 amid macro/fuel/geopolitical headwinds, before a projected sharp expansion. demand_drivers.title: Mdna (RHP)
demand_drivers.body:
- The Company remains focused on leveraging structural growth opportunities arising from digitalisation, artificial intelligence, digital payments, InsurTech, FinTech, travel, hospitality and changing consumer preferences.
- The financial year under review represented the Company's first full financial year of operations following completion of the Ebix Inc. acquisition, marked by continued integration, operational consolidation and efficiency initiatives.

moat.title: Strengths (RHP)
moat.body:
- scale: Diversified business portfolio spanning technology-enabled services, digital payments, InsurTech, travel technology, healthcare technology, e-learning, digital marketing, hospitality and QSR — evidence: SWOT 'Diversified Business Portfolio' disclosure that this reduces dependence on any single business segment.
- distribution: Established international presence and customer relationships across multiple geographies through the Ebix technology businesses — evidence: SWOT 'Global Presence and Customer Base' disclosure of an established presence across multiple international markets. — against it: Weaknesses disclose that realising the portfolio's potential 'depends on effective integration, operational improvement, technology investments and the ability to achieve anticipated synergies.'

strategy.title: Strategies (RHP)
strategy.body:
- Continue integrating and strengthening the Ebix technology businesses, improving operational efficiency and exploring cross-selling, technology-led innovation and expansion across markets.
- Focus on operational integration, strengthening technology platforms, expanding digital payments and technology-led solutions, and improving customer engagement across domestic and international markets.
- Going forward, focus on operational efficiency, cost optimisation, prudent resource utilisation, strengthening of internal processes and controls, effective integration of business operations and improvement in financial performance.
- Leverage business capabilities, technology platforms, customer relationships and geographical presence while maintaining operational discipline, efficiency and sustainable growth.
- Changed corporate name from 'Eraaya Lifespaces Limited' to 'Ebix Limited' (effective 18 June 2026) to align corporate identity with its expanded business profile and global operations following the Ebix Inc. acquisition.
